name: claude-harness
description: The Claude Harness family: Claude Code plugins that ship with the Claude Harness VS Code extension

plugins.name: harness-plugin
plugins.description: Offers the Claude Harness views as @harness: mentions with type-ahead, whose output Claude reads as context, and keeps a repo's harness in shape: checks the root CLAUDE.md against the router layout, keeps skill leaves small and routed, halts or steers a long run from a file at the project root, and on request holds a session end until a verification receipt exists
